note: Angles are degrees about the joint, X/Y/Z in the generator's frame (x right, y forward, z up); convert with to_bb (x,y,z)->(-x,z,y) like the parts. 12 frames = one stride, 0.5 s.
clips_note: Kill clips (Blender pass 420): angles like 'frames', 24 fps; 'root' = runner offset in model px (x right, y forward, z up) added to its position; 'target' = where the victim's middle is held, in model px (x right, y forward, z up) from a standing mob's middle (16 px up) at the runner's start position (null = released / thrown); 'hit' = the frame the kill lands.
